latest.notes:
See the total value of today’s orders alongside order and visit counts
Move directly to an in-progress visit, or close it and continue to another customer
Mobile invoice links use a cleaner compact header and address layout
Record collections against specific unpaid orders or opening balances
See when an opening balance is partially collected or fully collected
Delivery updates can automatically text the buyer and, when configured, the Owner or Manager
Order delivery messages can include the secure invoice link

Customer details now include an Orders tab with status, view, and receive-payment actions
Opening balances stay separate from wallet credit and show partially collected or collected status
Collections must be allocated to unpaid orders or opening balances before any excess becomes wallet credit
Configure automatic delivery SMS messages for buyers and Owners or Managers
Record when a customer cheque is given to another person and when it is returned
Export collection reports with the improved PDF and Excel layouts
Mobile invoice links use a cleaner compact header and address layout
